name: O-ID modular humanoid
summary: An industrial humanoid built around repair: joints, limbs and computers are separate modules (nine or more) that can be swapped in minutes on a factory floor. The Tokyo startup raised US$1.2M pre-seed in September 2026. Its indicative specs list a holonomic wheeled base, so the 'humanoid' label does not mean a walking biped.

sources.title: O-ID Raises $1.2M to Build Humanoids With Swappable Parts — Humanoids Daily
